jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales
jobs.program: NSW Clerkship Recruitment Program - 2027 Summer Clerkships (clerkships commencing late 2027/2028)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide dates for all NSW signatory firms: applications open 9:00am AEST Wednesday 9 June 2027 and offers can be made from 9:00am Wednesday 8 September 2027; 'closes' is null because the Law Society publishes two staggered closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) rather than one.

Firm's own early careers page publishes 2027 key dates aligned to the NSW scheme (applications open 9:00am AEST 9 June 2027; offers from 8 September 2027, to be accepted/declined by 1:00pm 9 September 2027); the ten-week programme is for penultimate-year law students, and no closing date was stated on the page.

Firm's careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, with a pre-registration option; only the month is published, so exact open/close dates cannot be confirmed.

jobs.jurisdiction: National (incl. Adelaide, Brisbane, Perth, Sydney, Melbourne)
jobs.notes: Firm's graduate centre page confirms the 2026/2027 round is closed and that 2027/2028 clerkships will be advertised in line with the relevant Law Society/Institute guidelines (SA Uniform Clerkship Scheme, QLS, Blackstone Society WA, etc.), but no 2027/2028 dates are published yet.

jobs.program: QLS Seasonal Clerkship and Graduate Recruitment - 2027 program cycle (graduate stream) and next clerkship cycle
jobs.notes: Official QLS scheme page confirms the Queensland cycle begins with clerkship recruitment each July/August (the 2027-cycle clerkship applications and 7 October 2026 offer date have already passed) and hosts the graduate key dates, but the specific forward graduate open/close dates could not be confirmed from the page, so they are left null rather than guessed.
